likhit-kai-yang.note: Not in OpenStreetMap. Re-checked 2026-09-19: Nominatim finds nothing for the Thai name, and an Overpass search of every restaurant, fast food and cafe within 500 m of Rajadamnern Stadium returns twelve venues, none of them this one. Needs coordinates read off a map.

moon-bar-banyan-tree.note: Pinned on Banyan Tree Bangkok, 21 Soi Suan Phlu 6, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, from Nominatim on 2026-09-19. Moon Bar is the hotel's 61st-floor rooftop, so the hotel is the right pin. The earlier run searched the bar name, which matches an unrelated Moon Bar in Chatuchak about 12 km away; the hotel name matches first time.

roof-at-sala-rattanakosin.note: Not in OpenStreetMap. Re-checked 2026-09-19: the name returns Wat Pho pavilions and Rattanakosin Island, an Overpass search of every tourism feature within 350 m of Tha Tien Pier lists the neighbouring hotels but not this one, and no building near the pier carries house number 39. Three unnamed hotel nodes stand nearby and cannot be told apart, so nothing is pinned. Needs coordinates read off a map.
